dedupe_keys.name: open multi hazard flood atlas singapore kuala lumpur bangkok and jakarta 30 m present ssp2 4 5 ssp5 8 5 x 2050 2100 rp10 100 1000

description: An independent flood-modelling researcher publishes design-event flood maps for Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok and Jakarta. Zenodo provides a city ZIP and public README under CC BY 4.0. Thirty-metre GeoTIFFs distinguish coastal, fluvial and pluvial flood depth and severity for the present day and SSP2-4.5 or SSP5-8.5 in 2050 or 2100, at ten-, hundred- and thousand-year return periods. The archives also describe elevation, HAND, forcing and a documented-hotspot validation register. These maps can drive building, road and utility exposure scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this four-city atlas. Coverage is design events under chosen methods and defences, not observed city-wide flood depths or continuous forecasts. A limitation is that different physical approximations are used for coastal, river and rainfall pathways; apparent differences between hazards need methodological interpretation. No city ZIP was downloaded, and raster completeness or hotspot validation was not recomputed.
